claims.claim: Staging requires one exact activated target and rejects a closed or mismatched activation before legacy attestation, lineage checks, transport staging, target launch, or RUN creation.

Bound target consumption does not read the activation slot. It checks the exact transport, stored intent, clean target checkout, target HEAD, running source, and failed-bootstrap lineage before delegating the bound selectors to the existing run_repair_wakeup().
Production source-REPAIR activation is None. The source-PRIMARY and bootstrap activation literals and existing lineage, replay, conflict, partial-state, and migration logic remain unchanged.

Regression coverage stages one exact transport, clears activation, and exercises --accept-transport from a separate exact target-source interpreter. It checks rejection before REPAIR delegation for path, intent, target HEAD, and running-source mismatches.

The portability documentation records the corrected two-stage boundary, the historical TASK-206/207 self-rejection, and the required separate activation successor without claiming RUN-255-003 recovery or BP-9 completion.
